subject: [hw] R1 -> lead: T01 differential table now runs; arm-O0 clean, thumb-O0 676 mismatches (V14), NEON narrow/widen still failing
body:
The full T01 suite now reaches the differential stage. Its table:
  arm-O0    2600/2600 pass, 0 mismatch (baseline: loader+core+A32 classes sound)
  arm-O2    2475 pass, 125 mismatch
  arm-O3v   2513 pass, 87 mismatch
  thumb-O0  1904 pass, 676 mismatch, 20 stop
  thumb-O2  2386 pass, 125 mismatch, 89 stop
  thumb-O3v 2404 pass, 107 mismatch, 89 stop
  armv8-O3v 2513 pass, 87 mismatch
  total 1405/18200 differ or missing
The arm-O2/armv8 mismatches are concentrated in NEON narrow/widen/scalar kernels (k_i8_loop, k_i16_loop, k_i16_mul, k_neon_vmla16, k_neon_vsubl, k_u8_sad) plus k_v15_extend; the thumb-O0 block is V14s F1/F4 (CBZ/CBNZ i=1 and LSR/ASR-register-0) corrupting ordinary code. T01 is bisecting and posting to the owners; I am not duplicating that. My per-package verdicts remain as in FINDINGS, with the differential table recorded as an open integration item.

Still open on my side: V14 F1/F2/F4 (patch ready, owner idle), V30 F15 (stack overflow, owner idle), V20 F16 is fixed and I am waiting for its DONE, V41/IV have no DONE yet. V32/V33/V34/V40/T02 accepted; V02/V03/V10/V11/V12/V15/V16/V17/V18/V19 accepted on their own suites + my spot checks.
